description.narrative: Partnership for learning for all in Nigeria - Plane Window 2 EiE The 3 year program in its second phase aims to provide out of school learners, particularly girls, who are affected by conflict with foundational learning skills through non-formal education. Beneficiaries are provided inclusive gender responsive and non-formal learning opportunities to enable the acquisition of basic literacy numeracy, manipulative, communicative and life skills. Employing an Accelerated Based Education Program (ABEP) that is fused with teaching at the right level approach will enable the learners to eventually transition into the education system. Girls will be supported to successfully complete primary and transition to junior secondary education and students included adolescents will be engaged in life skill trainings through JSS. A component includes CVA incentives with weekly discussion series to build gender transformative life skills and motivate their continued attendance._x000d_ the project supports the recovery of the education system in Borno and Yobe states by training 1200 volunteer teachers in ABEP interventions who subsequently receive onsite mentoring to support ABEP. The project supports the construction of accessible temporary learning centres that will be equipped with school kits and inclusive learning materials that adapt to those with disabilities and being easy to read to support those with learning difficulties. _x000d_ Community Management committees will ensure sustained effective governance and management of the ABEP centres. At the learning centres constructed gender segregated WASH latrines will be managed by WASH clubs that engage girls and adolescents empowering them to build agency and benefit from life skill sessions with a special focus on menstrual hygiene and SRHR for girls and adolescents and gender segregated latrines.
